clips.title: The story
paras: High above Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle awaits a bounty in the Stonetalon Mountains. The rogue gnome overseer has replaced much of his decaying flesh with gears, clockwork machinery, and artificial limbs. Ziz Fizziks wants his mechanical arm as proof of his death, hoping it will win him a promotion.

Gerenzo’s body bears the marks of his transformations. Those who have seen him say his natural flesh is rotting beneath grafted gears, iron plating, and whirring clockwork limbs. He watches operations from near the great water wheel above Cragpool Lake, with no concern for his failing flesh.

Ziz Fizziks works for Sputtervalve and hopes Gerenzo’s fall will carry him out of Stonetalon. Ziz cannot climb the cliffs and defeat the augmented overseer himself, so he asks you to bring back Gerenzo’s mechanical arm. With it, he hopes to prove his worth and earn a transfer to the Tinkers’ Union workshops in Gadgetzan or Undermine.

Gerenzo’s mechanical arm reflects a sharp divide between gnome and goblin engineering. He cut away failing flesh to make room for complex prosthetics, a choice goblins find baffling. As Ziz sees it, goblin ingenuity would keep the natural limb and add an explosive third arm beside it.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I met Gerenzo once, but let me tell you, he's not easy on the eyes. His flesh looks like it's rotting away, and he's grafted metal and gears onto his body, replaced some of his limbs with mechanical ones.

Northeast of here, far above Cragpool Lake, up near the water wheel is where Gerenzo watches over the entire site. There's no way I could fight my way up there, not to mention take on Gerenzo... But you look like you might be able to make it.
If you kill him for me, I'll make it worth your while!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sputtervalve will want some sort of proof that Gerenzo's dead. I think his mechanical arm will probably do.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Look at that thing... It'd take a gnome to come up with something like that. I can't understand why you'd cut off an arm, and replace it with that, when you could just keep both arms and add a third!
At least Gerenzo's out of commission. Hopefully that'll be enough proof, and Sputtervalve will assign me to one of the Tinkers' Union workshops in Gadgetzan or maybe even Undermine.
